summary: Cross-finding from wavelet coherence: the phase reversal (NH leads at 6-12 months, SH leads at 24-60 months) is a key property of the H004 coupled oscillator. The coupled system has two distinct coupling modes: (1) a fast mode (months) where NH drives SH (possibly via land-forced atmospheric teleconnections), and (2) a slow mode (ENSO timescales) where SH drives NH (likely via oceanic memory). This two-mode coupling structure is characteristic of a coupled oscillator with different components having different characteristic timescales — the fast NH-driven mode and the slow SH ocean-memory mode.
